title: Bound late-tail cleanup and expose the earlier exact interface
body:
## Summary

At the admitted caller's final-independent-a entrance, any new scalar/monomial cleanup topology with restored arbitrary dirty banks satisfies **R_f+S_f≥6f** for q2 or **≥8f** for q3. R_f sums actual same-volume full-bank native macroarities; S_f counts every binary ADD/COPY accumulation. One required current-input coefficient already has uniform row support2^(6f)/2^(8f).

The actual source suffixes are event69/119, with fixed prefix66f/120f, local native bill10f/12f and stock72f/128f. Complete arbitrary-input local matrices, both serialized inverse orders, selected recipes, embeddings and Gaussian tensor phases are retained. This permits new local ADD topology and restored dirt beyond [PR4080](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4080)'s fixed-graph and isolated-existing-site classes, while fixing this exact entrance/exit matrix.

## Scope and limits

The finite-f statement is R_f≥nf−S_f, n=6/8. For S_f=o(f), it yields limiting native mass at least stock after the unchanged prefix. It does not give a pointwise native-only floor when ADDs are present, establish the local optimum, or exclude earlier changed cuts/gauges/contracts. The conditional all-q lemma requires the displayed odd-plane tail pattern and stock+4 complete profile; complete physical bindings here are q2/q3.

The independently reviewed full-scan corollary additionally assumes actual work≥c V_f S_f for fixed c>0 and complete available overhead o(V_f f). A fixed native deficit then requires Ω(V_f f) scan work. Under equal-volume full-bank proper-child normalization the limiting native moments are at least `33(1/6)^(1−b)+(1/2)^(1−b)>6` and `60(1/8)^(1−b)+(1/2)^(1−b)>8` for0<b<1. An upper budget O(V_f f^λ P(f)) needs λ<1 and P(f)=o(f^(1−λ)); unrestricted precision/controller factors cannot be dropped. Partial, striped or fused-scan primitives need their own weighted proof. [FULL-SCAN-COROLLARY](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff277e8a958829954f371c85bdc447672266edbd/research/coupled-tail-support-floor/FULL-SCAN-COROLLARY.md) consumes only independently reviewed section4, with the complete raw threshold note retained as provenance. Its numerical/upstream planning claims are not adopted.

Scientific base `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, priority6 and original card remain pinned. Fresh canonical `bb4bccbf42844d2801487450727c2f63e10d1d0f` has only an unrelated sparse-baseline helper/test change; guidance and selected record are unchanged. This is the explicit donor-assigned late-cut continuation of PR4080, not a solution to the broad joint-query-controller card. Fresh bounded overlap covers80 open PRs,13 exact related heads and4 boards with partial pagination. [PR4081](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4081)'s response tariff has different separately charged-site premises.

No positive supplier, global caller/kernel optimum, all-q full compiler, complete owner/controller/precision/tape admission, formal-kernel proof, compatible BIT, selected-frontier change or new κ is claimed. [TASK.json](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff277e8a958829954f371c85bdc447672266edbd/research/coupled-tail-support-floor/TASK.json) records concrete next questions and blockers.

The separately reviewed **earlier cut58 next-interface appendix** gives an exact q2 current-input6×6 matrix, both inverses and source recipe/phase bindings at prefix54f/local22f. RP=−T allows a rank-neutral scalar/address simplification, still22f and whole76f versus stock72f. A hypothetical16f suffix would give70f, but that target remains OPEN: no native saving, optimality claim or newly admitted selected-native event schema is supplied. This explicit successor interface reopens an earlier entrance without broadening the late-cut floor. Only source inputs independently frozen before the research cutoff are consumed; no new search runs.

## Test plan

Exact reviewed head: `ff277e8a958829954f371c85bdc447672266edbd`.

- Registered Python3.12 normal/-O: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/coupled-tail-support-floor`.
- Exact committed bytes/source history: `python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/coupled-tail-support-floor --check-source-history`.
- Official export/integrity and read-only Git-free normal/-O replay, empty PATH and unchanged bytes/modes/inodes.
- Complete source produce functions and separate independent literal audit: every current input, both local inverse orders, exact source slices, used-only forward/inverse recipe pools, embeddings, all Gaussian f residues, explicit q2 prose inverse, full prefix/local bills and coefficient support witnesses.
- Omitted reverse native query, omitted incoming coefficient, f2-only phase, source/transport/logical damage and undeclared external reads/loads reject. Fixed-prefix histograms H2=33/60 are freshly recounted for the written moment corollary. q2..10 rank checks corroborate the conditional tail formula; they do not prove an all-q full caller.

[README](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff277e8a958829954f371c85bdc447672266edbd/research/coupled-tail-support-floor/README.md) and [REPLAY-MAP](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff277e8a958829954f371c85bdc447672266edbd/research/coupled-tail-support-floor/REPLAY-MAP.md) distinguish finite source checks, arbitrary-replacement written proof, conditional runtime transfer and physical admission. Two deterministic entry support-witness lowerings are rederived/recompiled; no cleanup factorization census or broad search runs. Complete raw and executed bytes are authenticated, including the original library implementations and unchanged math function/class source maps. Lossless in-memory gzip reduces transport, not mathematical review scope; no network, executable data or package writes.

Current [natural workflow39276431732](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39276431732) is **completed/success** at exact `ff277e8a958829954f371c85bdc447672266edbd`, read separately from full current-head local/export checks. Historical `3e6d682c278cdd0979b7f78d4fe18f304bde37da` passed [workflow39274489295](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39274489295); it is not the current-head CI receipt. No manual check/rerun or merge was requested.
